_meta._note: AAII reasoning-effort variant model registrations. AA publishes separate scores for the same parent model under different reasoning effort levels (xhigh/high/medium/low/Non-reasoning/max). Previously we deduplicated to single canonical model_id keeping highest. This ingest registers the variant entries as distinct model_ids (e.g., openai/gpt-5.5-xhigh, openai/gpt-5.5-high, openai/gpt-5.5-medium, openai/gpt-5.5-low) for granular AAII analysis. Covers top-tier flagships (GPT-5.5 family, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4 family, DeepSeek V4 family, Gemini 3 Pro, Amazon Nova 2.0).
